title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: We're ready for the next thing

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: We're ready for the next thing
sources.description: One of Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald's talking points this offseason was the need for the team to "run it forward" after winning the Super Bowl and that mindset was on players' minds on Friday.
